the-yellow-door.tagline: National Lampoon comedy club in the Gaslamp
the-yellow-door.description: An intimate National Lampoon-branded comedy club in the Gaslamp Quarter with nightly stand-up shows, a full bar and food menu.

toro.tagline: Two-level nightclub and taco cantina on Fifth Ave
toro.description: A two-level bar/nightclub and gourmet taco cantina on Fifth Avenue playing Top 40 and Latin/reggaeton across multiple floors with live DJs.

garage-kitchen-bar.tagline: Gaslamp sports bar with brunch and craft burgers
garage-kitchen-bar.description: A high-energy downtown sports bar known for happy hour, bottomless-mimosa brunch, big-screen game-day watch parties and craft burgers.

good-night-john-boy.tagline: 1970s disco bar and dance club in the Carriage Works
good-night-john-boy.description: An 11,000-sq-ft 1970s-themed disco bar and nightclub inside the historic Carriage Works building, spinning 70s/80s remixes with themed events.

el-after-social-club.tagline: Late-night Latin dance club and bar in the Gaslamp
el-after-social-club.description: A late-night restaurant, bar and dance club in the Gaslamp with a full food menu and DJ-driven nights leaning Latin, reggaeton, house and hip-hop.

laugh-factory.tagline: San Diego outpost of the Laugh Factory comedy chain
laugh-factory.description: The San Diego location of the national Laugh Factory brand, a stand-up comedy club with 21+ shows and a two-item minimum.

cafe-sevilla.tagline: Spanish tapas restaurant with a nightclub downstairs
cafe-sevilla.description: A longtime Spanish tapas bar and restaurant on Fifth Avenue serving tapas and paella, with an attached Sevilla Nightclub for late-night Latin dancing.

onyx-room.description: A downtown Gaslamp nightclub with multiple rooms spanning hip-hop, top hits, reggaeton and a Latin salsa/bachata room.

f6ix.tagline: Underground hip-hop nightclub in the Gaslamp
f6ix.description: A 6,000-sq-ft underground hip-hop nightclub beneath F Street and Sixth Avenue in the Gaslamp Quarter.

hard-rock-hotel-san-diego.tagline: Music-themed hotel at the Gaslamp entrance
hard-rock-hotel-san-diego.description: A music-themed hotel at the entrance to the Gaslamp Quarter, steps from the convention center and one block from Petco Park, with dining and event venues.

hilton-san-diego-gaslamp-quarter.hours: Front desk open 24 hours; check-in 4pm, check-out 11am
hilton-san-diego-gaslamp-quarter.tagline: Upscale hotel at the gateway to the Gaslamp
hilton-san-diego-gaslamp-quarter.description: Full-service Hilton hotel across from the San Diego Convention Center and three blocks from Petco Park, with an outdoor pool, fitness center, and on-site dining.

mad-house-comedy-club.description: Downtown Gaslamp comedy club featuring established and up-and-coming stand-up comedians, located in the historic Ingle Building at 4th & F.

wild-hare-bar.tagline: Rabbit-themed garden bar at the Hilton Gaslamp
wild-hare-bar.description: An indoor-outdoor, rabbit-themed bar and restaurant at the Hilton San Diego Gaslamp Quarter serving California cuisine, brunch and cocktails.

prohibition-lounge.description: A Prohibition-era speakeasy in the Gaslamp entered through a discreet 'law office' door, offering craft cocktails and nightly live jazz and blues.

american-junkie.tagline: Gaslamp sports bar by day, nightclub by night
american-junkie.description: A Fifth Avenue bar and nightclub that runs as a sports bar during the day and shifts to a high-energy club atmosphere at night.

whiskey-girl.description: One of the longest-running entertainment venues in the Gaslamp, serving American classics, 70+ whiskeys, nightly live music and video DJs, with all sports packages.

nova-sd.tagline: 22,000 sq ft EDM nightclub in the Gaslamp
nova-sd.description: A 22,000-square-foot indoor-outdoor Downtown nightclub that opened in 2022, featuring a large main-room dance floor and EDM programming.

casablanca-lounge.description: A Fifth Avenue hookah lounge near the Gaslamp arch offering an extensive selection of flavored shisha, drinks and patio seating.

wine-girl-san-diego.tagline: Instagram-ready wine bar with signature swings
wine-girl-san-diego.description: A pastel-pink Gaslamp wine bar (opened 2025) with rotating wines on tap, curated bottles, shareable bites and photo-ready swings.

the-tipsy-crow.description: A three-level historic Gaslamp bar with a Main Bar, upstairs Nest lounge and the Underground dance space, offering cocktails, food and dancing.

vybz-kitchen-lounge.description: A lively Gaslamp kitchen and cocktail lounge at 840 Fifth Ave with a full bar, 35 TVs, mezzanine VIP bottle service and late-night dancing.

sidebar.tagline: Intimate boutique nightclub & lounge in the Gaslamp
sidebar.description: A downtown San Diego nightlife staple since 2003, renovated into a New York-style boutique club and lounge with craft cocktails, live DJs and VIP table service.

andaz-san-diego.tagline: Boutique Gaslamp hotel with a rooftop bar & pool
andaz-san-diego.description: A 159-room lifestyle boutique hotel by Hyatt in a historic 1913 building at 600 F St, featuring RoofTop600, the Gaslamp Quarter's largest rooftop with a restaurant, bar and pool.

el-chingon.description: A high-energy Mexican restaurant and bar at 560 Fifth Ave serving classic tacos and burritos, over-the-top plates, a deep tequila/mezcal list and live DJs.

urban-india-restaurant-bar.tagline: Modern Indian dining & weekend DJ bar
urban-india-restaurant-bar.description: Established in 2012, this Gaslamp Indian restaurant at 750 Fifth Ave serves traditional dishes with a modern twist plus a beer-and-wine bar, becoming a DJ-driven bar on weekends.

moxy-san-diego-gaslamp-quarter.hours: Open 24 hours (front desk); check-in at the bar
moxy-san-diego-gaslamp-quarter.tagline: Playful, design-forward Gaslamp hotel with Bar Moxy
moxy-san-diego-gaslamp-quarter.description: A chic Marriott Moxy hotel at 831 Sixth Ave with 126 rooms, a marine theme, a lively lobby Bar Moxy where guests check in and 24/7 grab-and-go food and drinks.

taste-thirst.tagline: Gaslamp sports bar with Southern eats & happy hour
taste-thirst.description: Established in 2008 at 715 Fourth Ave, a laid-back Gaslamp sports bar and eatery with 14 HD TVs, Southern-inspired fare, cocktails and daily happy hour specials.

gaslamp-museum-at-the-davis-horton-house.tagline: San Diego's oldest house & Gaslamp history museum
gaslamp-museum-at-the-davis-horton-house.description: Housed in the 1850 Davis-Horton House, the oldest structure in the Gaslamp Quarter, this museum offers self-guided and audio tours plus weekly walking tours.

horton-plaza-park.tagline: Historic downtown plaza with the 1910 Broadway Fountain
horton-plaza-park.description: A 1.8-acre downtown park at Fourth & Broadway featuring the restored 1910 Broadway Fountain, an interactive pop-jet fountain and an amphitheater; hosts concerts and film screenings.

san-diego-free-tour.tagline: Pay-what-you-wish Gaslamp walking tours, EN & ES
san-diego-free-tour.description: A pay-as-you-wish walking tour operator meeting by the Gaslamp Quarter Arch on Fifth Ave, running roughly two-hour guided tours in English and Spanish.

saya-brasserie.tagline: Dubai-born pink brasserie cafe in the Gaslamp
saya-brasserie.description: A Dubai-born, social-media-driven cafe brasserie serving breakfast and lunch fare in the Gaslamp Quarter, its U.S. debut location.

bang-san-diego.tagline: Sushi, flaming boats and a giant disco ball
bang-san-diego.description: Bang SD (formerly Bang on 5th) is a multi-level Asian-fusion restaurant and nightclub in the Gaslamp featuring sushi, craft cocktails, live DJs and a huge disco ball.

vin-de-syrah-nightclub.tagline: Whimsical underground wine and cocktail parlor
vin-de-syrah-nightclub.description: An Alice-in-Wonderland-themed underground spirit and wine parlor in the Gaslamp with botanical decor, bistro bites and weekend DJs and live jazz.

double-deuce.description: A multi-level country-and-rock entertainment bar in the Gaslamp with San Diego's only mechanical bull, video DJs, karaoke and beer pong.

blarney-stone-pub.tagline: San Diego's original Gaslamp Irish pub
blarney-stone-pub.description: A family-run Irish pub in the Gaslamp Quarter serving Guinness, pub grub and burgers with live Irish music and an old-Ireland atmosphere.

hotel-indigo-san-diego-gaslamp-quarter.tagline: Boutique IHG hotel with a rooftop bar
hotel-indigo-san-diego-gaslamp-quarter.description: A boutique IHG hotel near Petco Park featuring a rooftop bar and lounge overlooking the East Village and ballpark.

5-o-clock-somewhere-rooftop-bar.tagline: Margaritaville rooftop bar near Petco Park
5-o-clock-somewhere-rooftop-bar.description: The rooftop bar atop the Margaritaville Hotel San Diego in the Gaslamp, serving frozen cocktails and island fare with East Village and ballpark views.

petco-park.hours: Varies by event; tours daily (see padres.com)
petco-park.tagline: Downtown ballpark, home of the Padres
petco-park.description: The downtown San Diego ballpark that opened in 2004 and is home to the MLB San Diego Padres, hosting games, concerts and daily ballpark tours.

havana-1920.tagline: Authentic Cuban cuisine and cafe in the Gaslamp
havana-1920.description: A Cuban restaurant and cafe in the Gaslamp Quarter serving authentic Cuban dishes, mojitos and a morning cafe with coffee and sandwiches.

aka-san-diego.description: An Asian-fusion restaurant, bar and lounge that opened November 2024 in the former Lavo space in the Gaslamp, with a dining-and-nightlife concept.

bards-cards.tagline: Board games, TCGs and tabletop play in the Gaslamp
bards-cards.description: A tabletop game shop and community play space in downtown San Diego stocking board games, Magic, Pokemon and RPGs, with weekly tournaments and open play nights.

tivoli-bar-and-grill.tagline: San Diego's oldest bar, pouring since the 1880s
tivoli-bar-and-grill.description: A historic Gaslamp dive bar billed as San Diego's oldest, dating to the 1880s, with an original wood bar, many beers on tap and casual grill food.

the-sinclair-on-g-street.tagline: Historic brick event and wedding space in the Gaslamp
the-sinclair-on-g-street.description: A 5,700-sq-ft creative event and wedding venue in a historic Gaslamp building featuring exposed brick, vaulted ceilings, wood floors and seating for about 165.

pushkin-lounge-bar.description: An upscale Gaslamp lounge and bar serving Russian and European-inspired cuisine with a full cocktail bar and hookah.

casa-octavio.hours: Mon 2pm-12am, Tue-Sat 11am-12am, Sun brunch to evening
casa-octavio.tagline: Elevated Mexican with tequila and mezcal cocktails
casa-octavio.description: A lively Gaslamp Mexican restaurant and mezcal/tequila cocktail bar near Petco Park, known for street tacos, ceviche, mole, weekend brunch and bottomless mimosas.

stk-steakhouse.tagline: Chic steakhouse and rooftop at the Andaz
stk-steakhouse.description: An upscale, high-energy steakhouse on the ground floor of Andaz San Diego in the Gaslamp, with a rooftop lounge, weekend brunch and daily happy hour.

uc-san-diego-park-market.tagline: UC San Diego's downtown events and learning hub
uc-san-diego-park-market.description: A four-story UC San Diego mixed-use building in East Village hosting public programs, exhibitions and events, including the 220-seat Guggenheim Theatre.
